text: F14.1: Scheidt's mask as a keyword alphabet before a keyed table: two scrambled alphabets, each from an English word, and a key word.
Every pair of 208,064 alphabets, matched exactly through an index of the gaps the known letters ask for; the forced key checked against every word.
No key word on K4 or any shuffle; plants 12/12. K4's 5 pairs at length 16 replicated against 1,000 fresh shuffles: p 0.009, not a flag (0245).
